title: Voltpilot Redpanda telemetry.raw Event
description: Event written by the Ingest service to the Redpanda topic `telemetry.raw` after validating an inbound MQTT telemetry payload. Consumed by the TimescaleDB-Writer (and, independently, by any future feature/alerting/live-view consumer on the same log). BINDING contract (architecture sections 7 and 20 item 8). Topic is partitioned by tenant_id/site_id; the Kafka record key is `{tenant_id}:{site_id}`.

x-kafka.partitioning: by tenant_id/site_id for ordered per-site processing

event_id.description: Unique id assigned by Ingest; enables idempotent writes downstream.

observed_at.description: Original measurement timestamp from the edge payload (`ts`).

ingested_at.description: Time the Ingest service accepted the message.

measurements.description: Validated measurement block, carried through unchanged from the MQTT payload (see mqtt-telemetry.schema.json).
